messages:
Sam (AE): Heads-up: Orbit wants to run a short validation with a new community variant 'orbit-instruct-20b-quant-lite' against our catalog. They care about latency and a clean security reply for their procurement team. Can infra confirm runnable footprint and a rough POC spend?
Ivy (Infra Eng): Should be fine. Estimate ~40GB VRAM with quant-lite on A100. Need to verify tokenizer parity and KV-cache warmup curves. I'll run a quick smoke and post numbers.
Sam (AE): They also asked if we can provide a temporary tenant-scoped token and whether logs are segregated.
Marta (Security): We provide tenant isolation and per-tenant audit logs. Sandbox retention is 7d; production default 30d (extendable). I'll draft SSQ answers; flagging model provenance question if the weights are vendor-supplied.
Diego (Solutions): I'll prepare a 1-page tech note: recommended batch=2-6, seq cap=1024, fallback route example, and a tiny curl for them to run.
Sam (AE): Pricing: Orbit expects ~800k tokens/day. Any per-token difference for quant-lite?
Ivy (Infra Eng): Token billing unchanged. Quant changes infra cost only. Ballpark hosted POC = $0.085 /k tokens for this workload; dedicated commit roughly 30-45% off depending on term. Will confirm with pricing team.
Ivy (Infra Eng): running smoke now: posting sample output in a sec.
ticket-bot: provision/orbit-sandbox created on cluster-c (A100), token=REDWOOD-ORBIT-POC, status=ready
Sam (AE): Great — please add recommended A/B sanity checks for quality vs non-quant. Diego, can you include a CSV template for ratings?
Diego (Solutions): Yep. Recommend 300-shot A/B with edge-case buckets + human score columns. I'll paste templates and the curl snippet.
Marta (Security): Drafting SSQ items for KMS, data handling, SSO, and retention. If Orbit requests attestations on model license we need legal lead time.
Sam (AE): Perfect. Tasks: Diego - tech note + templates. Ivy - smoke run + exact pricing. Marta - SSQ draft. I'll compile and send to Orbit once we have artifacts.
